title: The Ramparts of Ice Reveals Season 2 Announcement Trailer
content: The previously announced The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 revealed an announcement trailer on Saturday. The sequel is set to premiere on October 1 this year with studio KAI returning to animate.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't A Guy at All Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, Staff, Nirvana Opening Song, January 2027 Debut
content: Aniplex unveiled a teaser trailer and visual for the anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All ( Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko Janakatta ) manga on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 3 New Shonen Anime to Watch This Summer (& Where to Find Them)
content: It’s been a great year for anime lovers, with the winter and spring 2026 seasons offering incredible new releases, from Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Culling Game arc to Fullmetal Alchemist creator’s Daemons of the Shadow Realm .
author: ComicBook

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime's 2nd Season Previewed in Teaser Video
content: The staff for the second season of the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga revealed a teaser video on Saturday. The video was first revealed at Anime Expo on Friday. Ayumu Watanabe ( Ace Attorney , Doraemon films) directed the first season at BUG FILMS .
author: ANN

title: Anime Expo 2026: Every Major Anime Announced
content: Anime Expo 2026 has revealed some major anime announcements for the future, so here’s a breakdown of all the important news you need to keep an eye out on. It’s the start of July, and that means a new Summer of anime has begun.

title: 'Dengeki Daisy' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed the main cast and a teaser promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy manga on Friday. The anime series will begin airing in 2027. Voice actors Yoshino Aoyama ( Bocchi the Rock!

title: Toaru Anbu no Item Anime Unveils Trailer, Theme Song Artists, October 9 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item (A Certain ITEM of the Dark Side) spinoff novel revealed on Friday a new trailer, the theme song artists, and the October 9 premiere.
author: ANN

title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 5's Teaser Reveals Staff, 2027 Debut
content: Kadokawa unveiled a new teaser trailer and visual for the fifth season of The Rising of the Shield Hero anime on Saturday. The trailer reveals the fifth season's staff and 2027 debut.
author: ANN

title: Dark Horse Manga Licenses The Sky is but One Roof of the World, H.P. Lovecraft's The Haunter of the Dark Manga
content: Dark Horse Manga announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Friday it has licensed the following manga for release in spring 2027. All the works are available for pre-order now.
author: ANN

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms 2nd Season Anime Reveals January 2027 Debut
content: The staff for the second season of the television anime of Ran Kuze 's Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsūjinai ) manga announced in a teaser video on Friday the season will air in January 2027. Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP .
author: ANN
